kurz: The same beans turn bright green or olive grey, depending on cooking time and acid.
bild_im_kopf: Like a spotlight that flares up and then fades: cooked briefly the green shines, cooked long it fades away.
beobachtung: After 2 minutes the beans glow. After 10 minutes they are duller, and in the acidic pot clearly olive green.
erklaerung: Brief cooking drives air out of the tissue and the green glows. Longer cooking and acid turn the [[chlorophyll-farbe|chlorophyll]] into an olive-brown pigment.
schritte: Bring both pots to the boil; add a splash of lemon juice to one.
Divide the beans between both pots.
After 2 minutes put a few beans from each into the iced water; cook the rest for 10 minutes more.
